speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: The scheme was enhanced in August 2015 in three main areas.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: Previously, only students and working adults with disabilities could tap on the fund.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: Persons with disabilities can use the fund for various purposes, ranging Page: 20 from education, employment to independent living.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: We recognise that the needs for assistive technology may change as persons with disabilities transit into different life-stages or they may require several replacements of devices or aids over time.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: To enable ease of application by persons with disabilities, SG Enable which administers the scheme, has simplified the application process.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: SG Enable has also set up a TechAble centre at the Enabling Village to encourage and facilitate the adoption of assistive technology.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: Persons with disabilities can approach the centre to assess their needs and seek advice on different types of devices such as motorised wheelchairs.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: With such support, those with disabilities and their caregivers can make better informed decisions on assistive technology.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: We will continue to monitor the needs of persons with disabilities and how the ATF supports them.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: SG Enable and the Agency for Integrated Care are doing quite good work here.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: I guess my request is really to look further into the assistive technology landscape to see if there are some more gaps and opportunities that can be leveraged upon.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: One, would the Ministry consider taking a deeper look into the total lifetime cost for the major disability groups?

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: How much would it cost, including, for instance, wheelchairs, especially because our country is really on a very rapidly ageing trend?

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: That is one, study the total lifetime cost of assistive devices.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: The second one is, really, if there are more and more people, for example, using wheelchairs, including specialised or motorised wheelchairs, is there some opportunity that can be identified, so that persons who need to replace them, who need to use them on a very regular basis, can be helped further?

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: We can study to see if there are more economies of scale and what more can be done.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: Currently, under this free market mechanism, there are more and more models of wheelchairs, more and more specialised, more complicated models.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: And every time you see that, when the average lower-income wheelchair user wants to replace their wheelchairs, they have a lot of problems because either the parts are not available or the vendors are simply not interested.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: I hope that the Ministry would be able to look into it, especially these two areas, study the total lifetime cost for the use of assistive devices and look into opportunities for more economies of scale.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: Our effort and purpose are to enhance the lives of fellow Singaporeans and we will do that.
